notes: Pantry night. Used the last of the anchovies.
tweak_notes: More chilli, less salt in the pasta water.

notes: Loud room, long wait between courses.
First time with the pickles made the night before.
tweak_notes: Make double the pickles; they went in two days.

notes: Sunday. Potatoes were the best part and the sauce split slightly.
tweak_notes: Mount the butter off the heat.

notes: Everything cooked to order, so we sat for two hours.
Broth simmered while I worked. Herbs were tired.
tweak_notes: Buy the herbs the same day or do not bother.

notes: Batch for the week. Salsa was better on day three.
Stew, and enough banchan to make a second meal.
Second run. Doubled the pickles as planned.
Long braise on a cold evening.
tweak_notes: Half the ras el hanout, twice the preserved lemon.
